prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: website editorial article cover, wide 16:9. Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 is the website palette and pixel texture reference ONLY. Restyle the entire first image to belong to the second image's near-black, muted atmospheric blue and hot ember orange ordered-dither aesthetic. Preserve hallway photograph on left, notebook on right, fine timeline and dialogue outlines, and exact central text "then / now". Replace all white paper with near-black charcoal, photographic fragments in blue/cyan pixel halftone, delicate cool blue diagram lines, restrained orange/red accents and a subtle diagonal atmospheric glow. Crisp visible square ordered-dither pixels throughout imagery; dark negative space. Title must remain highly readable in pale ice blue, neutral sans serif. Keep the original editorial collage composition and recognizable subjects but fully transform colors and surface textures. No white paper, no lavender, no website UI or card captions, no rounded border, no additional text. Output only one finished full-bleed 16:9 cover image, not a website screenshot.
